diagnosis.full_analysis:
DIAGNOSIS: Generated code is rendering raw markdown instead of formatted text in PDF because the LLM response contains markdown syntax that reportlab Paragraph objects don't automatically parse or render

CONFIDENCE: 92

RECOMMENDATIONS: 1. Add markdown-to-reportlab conversion logic in the PDF generation code to strip or convert markdown syntax (**, *, #, etc.) before passing text to Paragraph objects 2. Update the LLM research prompt to explicitly request plain text without markdown formatting, or HTML if reportlab supports it 3. Implement text preprocessing that removes common markdown patterns (bold **, italic *, headers #) before PDF rendering 4. Consider using reportlab's HTML paragraph support (Paragraph with HTML tags) and convert markdown to HTML instead of stripping it 5. Test the fix by regenerating code and verifying PDF output shows formatted text instead of raw markdown symbols

EXPLANATION: The execution logs show successful PDF generation (attempt 2 passed), but the user reports raw markdown appearing in the PDF. The generated code at line 134-150 processes LLM response text directly into reportlab Paragraph objects without any markdown parsing or stripping. When the LLM returns text like "**Game Title**" or "*recommended*", reportlab renders these literally as asterisks rather than formatting. The code needs preprocessing to either strip markdown syntax or convert it to reportlab-compatible formatting before PDF generation.
